text:
Maria K: Quick preflight for Thursday's customer workshop (ScaleBench). Need a last-pass on registration page, Zoom recording settings, and post-event follow-up flow. I sketched owners below — pls confirm.

Josh P: On it. paste the Zoom config you want locked?

Maria K: Zoom settings I propose:
```
- Record meeting automatically to cloud (host only)
- Record separate audio files: ON
- Add timestamps to cloud recording: OFF
- Enable live transcript (auto-captions) -> SRT export after meeting
- Disable participant recording
- Waiting room: OFF (we'll use passcode)
```

Emily W: Looks good. Two notes: enable "Allow host to pause recording" and set co-hosts to Sarah + Ops so we can start if I get pulled.

Maria K: Good call. Updated owners: co-hosts: Emily W, Diane. Ops will start recording at 9:55.

Diane: I can start recording and check captions. I'll also grab the SRT and upload to our transcript pipeline (templated job: transcripts->rev->srt->storage). ops-bot will ping when upload is done.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: Zoom meeting 2026-04-15 10:00 PDT — 30 min before: send start checklist to #marketing-ops.

Josh P: Registration page checklist: form fields, GDPR consent, UTMs, and redirect after submit. Maria, what's our post-submit CTA?

Maria K: CTA -> "Add to calendar" + thank-you copy with link to prep doc. HubSpot form ID: 5f3a7b9c. Map fields: email, name, company, role, consent_checkbox, use_case (optional). UTM params we capture: utm_source=asana, utm_campaign=scalebench_launch, utm_medium=web.

Emily W: Can we add an optional checkbox for "share use case in advance" so speakers can prep? If yes, map to contact property: event_use_case.

Maria K: Yes. Also routing: any lead who checks box -> score +50 and send to nurture-list: "ScaleBench interest". Sync to HubSpot list: ScaleBench-INT. Zapier flow: form -> hubspot -> crm tag + slack notify (#sales-inbound).

Diane: Post-event follow-up plan (short):
- 0-24h: Thank-you + recording link + short survey (1 question).
- 48h: Segment: engaged (watched >50% or answered survey) -> personalized outreach templates.
- 7d: All registrants -> benchmarking blog + invite to demo.

Maria K: Draft of 0-24h email subject + snippet:
"Thanks for joining ScaleBench — here's the recording"
Snippet: "Hi {{first_name}}, thanks for coming. Recording + highlights attached. If you flagged a use case, your assigned AE will reach out. Quick 30s survey? [link]"

Josh P: Can we auto-generate a captioned clip (30s highlight) for LinkedIn? Ops: create clip workflow: SRT + timestamp markers -> ffmpeg trim -> upload to assets. Who owns?

Diane: Ops can produce one highlight clip within 48h. Assign to: Diane (owner), Emily (social copy), Maria (approve).

Maria K: Final asks before I lock everything at noon today: 1) Confirm co-host list (Emily, Diane) 2) HubSpot form mapping confirmed 3) Zapier -> #sales-inbound mapping ok 4) Ops to produce clip and SRT pipeline. Reply here with :thumbsup: when done.

Emily W: :thumbsup:

Josh P: :thumbsup:

Diane: :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Note: recording will be retained for 30 days per default policy. Request extended retention via ticket #IT-4521 if needed.

Maria K: Thanks everyone — I'll post final checklist in #marketing-ops and lock the page.
